title: Te Tuku i Whakarerekē i te Ao Tūturu
intro: I ngā rā tōmua o te tangata, i tuku te wairua i tētahi koha me ngā whakaaro parakore. Heoi, i noho puku te hae i roto i te atarangi o te manako. Tirohia te kōrero mō tēnei tangata, ko tōna karakia me tōna mutunga pōuri kua whakatōkia tonutia i roto i te whakakitenga atua.
clues: Ko ahau tētahi o ngā whakatipuranga tuatahi o te tangata.
I tuku atu ahau i tētahi whakahere ki tōku Ariki, ā, i manakohia mai.
I whakakahoretia te whakahere a tōku tuakana, ā, i pōuri te ngākau o te hae.
Ka mea atu ahau ki a ia, 'Ki te totoro mai tō ringa ki ahau hei patu i ahau, e kore ahau e totoro atu i tōku ringa ki te patu i a koe; he pono e wehi ana ahau i a Allah, i te Ariki o ngā ao.'
I riro ahau hei patunga mō te mahi kohuru tuatahi i runga i te whenua.
I karanga mai ōku toto, ā, ko ahau te mātāra tuatahi o te harakore.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Hāpiri (Āpera)
Qabil (Kaina)
Te Tangata nō Ya-Sin
Te Hāmiri
Lukmana

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: I manakohia tana whakahere, ā, ka hae tōna tuakana, ka kohurutia ia.
I makaia ia ki roto i te oumu mura, engari i puta mai ia, kāore i whara
I hanga e ia tētahi kaipuke nui i raro i te arataki a te Atua
I horomia ia e te ika nui, ā, noho tonu i te pōuri
I ārahi ia i tōna iwi i roto i te moana pakarukaru
trial.answer: I manakohia tana whakahere, ā, ka hae tōna tuakana, ka kohurutia ia.

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: He whakahere kua whakaaetia
He tokotoko e huri ana hei nakahi
He kamera uha hei tohu atua
He hūpō e kawe mai ana i ngā rongo
He kuao kau koura i karakiatia

outcome.label: Hua
options: Kohuru tuatahi i roto i te hītori; i whakataua tōna teina
Horomia ana e te whenua me ōna taonga
I hurihia hei makimaki nā te takahi ture
I whakangaromia e te hau nui, te hau hukapapa
I toremi i roto i te waipuke nui hei whiu
outcome.answer: Kohuru tuatahi i roto i te hītori; i whakataua tōna teina

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
